payload.reason: The evidence provides specific machine learning and deep learning methods used for Recognizing Question Entailment (RQE) in the context of question answering systems, particularly in the medical domain.

claims.text: Machine learning methods for RQE include Logistic Regression, which classifies question pairs into entailment or no-entailment.
Deep learning methods for RQE include Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs), Long Short Term Memory cells (LSTMs), and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs).
The best performing system utilized a learning-to-rank method with Logistic Regression and neural network embeddings such as Bi-LSTM and CNNs.
